LESSON 31 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Select, textarea and datalist

Select offers fixed choices, textarea accepts multiline text, and datalist provides suggestions for an
input without necessarily restricting its value.
select එකෙ predefined options Jදෙයි. textarea එකෙ multiline text සඳහා. datalist එකෙ suggestions Jදෙයි; user ට Jවනත් value එකෙකේ type කෙරන්නත් පුළුවන්.
A feedback form lets a customer choose a category and describe a problem.
Feedback form · Category (select) · Delivery ▾ · Message (textarea) · My order arrived late. · City (datalist) · Colombo

Read the diagram: Use select when a known option should be chosen, textarea for longer text, and
datalist for suggestions. Give every control a label and name.

<label>Category <select name="category">
  <option value="delivery">Delivery</option>
</select></label>
<label>Message <textarea name="message"></textarea></label>
<label>City <input name="city" list="cities"></label>
<datalist id="cities"><option value="Colombo"></datalist>
Expected result: A dropdown, multiline text field and city suggestion control appear.
Interview question: Does datalist restrict values to the listed options?
Answer: No. Validate on the server if only listed values are allowed.
Remember: Select = choices; textarea = long text; datalist = suggestions.
Practice: Add two categories and three cities.
